title: Copy Column Widths (Tables)

scenarios.title: Copy Column Widths applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Copy Column Widths (BtnTableColumnWidth) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Copy Column Widths keeps the proportions of the copied widths and lands on the target total exactly
scenarios.expected: oPenEfficiency.Core.Tests drives the host-neutral production code of Copy Column Widths (Tables): TableDimensionScaler.ScaleToTotal is asserted against the real scaling contract - copy Column Widths keeps the proportions of the copied widths and lands on the target total exactly.

scenarios.title: BtnTableColumnWidth copy/paste deterministic Office leg

requirements.text: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the Copy Column Widths command captures the fixture 3x3 table's 100/100/100 pt widths, the seam then mutates them to 60/120/120 pt, and the paste restores all three columns to 100 pt with the 300 pt total width, all texts and row heights untouched, reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the Copy Column Widths command captures the fixture 3x3 table's 100/100/100 pt widths, the seam then mutates them to 60/120/120 pt, and the paste restores all three columns to 100 pt with the 300 pt total width, all texts and row heights untouched, reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.
